assertions.name: zD_minus_bar_zD_is_exactly_h
assertions.source: sympy simplifies z_D - bar(z_D) - h to exactly 0; numerically the residual is < 1e-45 at both anchors (proton 4.52784e-72). This is the identity that makes the D-frame anomaly a closed form rather than a measured number.

assertions.name: alphaD_bar_anomaly_equals_h_squared_over_two
assertions.source: bar(alpha_D) + alpha_D - h^2/2 simplifies to 0 symbolically and is < 1e-45 at both anchors -- the closed form of the anomaly the eigenphase probe measured.

assertions.name: C_is_bar_odd_and_projected_D_is_bar_odd_but_raw_D_is_not
assertions.source: z_C is exactly bar-fixed and alpha_C exactly bar-odd; the projected D phase (alpha_D - h^2/4) is exactly bar-odd; the RAW D phase is not (its bar-sum is h^2/2 != 0). The three together are the iff of phaseTwice_bar_odd_iff_z_bar_fixed instantiated at both conventions.

description: Closed form for the Q_beta ladder phase's bar-anomaly, backing the numerically-measured D-frame projection. For alpha = (z-1)h/2 with h bar-odd, bar(alpha)+alpha = h*(z - bar z)/2 for ANY z, so the phase is mirror-covariant iff z is exactly bar-fixed (QOU.QBeta.phaseTwice_bar_odd_iff_z_bar_fixed, sorry-free). Convention C's z = sqrt(q)/(1+q) IS bar-fixed (corpus lemma z_bar_invariant_field, PR #3449) so alpha_C is bar-odd by structure. Convention D's z = q^3/(q^2+1) is not, and its anomaly is EXACTLY h: z_D - bar(z_D) = q - 1/q, symbolically and at both anchors. Hence bar(alpha_D)+alpha_D = h^2/2 and the projection alpha_D - h^2/4 is the UNIQUE mirror-covariant part -- forced, not fitted (QOU.QBeta.phaseTwiceD_sub_hsq_bar_odd). Motivation for using bar-parity as the test: the Ocneanu trace needs a writhe-dependent framing prefactor (Jones 1987 Sec. 5) and writhe is mirror-odd (WritheMarkovInvariance.writhe_inv), so a framing phase must be bar-odd. SCOPE: closes nothing. The projected D phase still leaves a residual ~42x the C-frame one; that residual is untouched and the standing fence against hunting further phase corrections holds. No value wired, no tier moved, D stays canonical.
